about_the_game:
From the creators of Shadowgate and the team behind the beloved NES version of The Uninvited comes a brand-new chapter in supernatural horror: The Uninvited II: Let Nothing You Dismay.

You are Mina Harper  — a paranormal investigator haunted by the demon known as Big Red, whose essence you carry like a curse. A decade after surviving the nightmare that claimed your family, you are called to another mansion steeped in tragedy. This is no ordinary haunted house — its walls hold memories, curses, and voices that demand to be heard.

Explore its shadowed rooms, glimpse the past through psychic visions, and uncover the truth hidden in its bones. Every clue brings you closer to salvation… and closer to losing yourself.

Key Features

  • A True Sequel: A direct continuation of the 8-bit cult hit The Uninvited with modern design sensibilities.

  • Authentic Pixel Art: Hand-crafted visuals that faithfully capture the eerie charm of the NES era.

  • Paranormal Investigation Gameplay: Solve mysteries by uncovering evidence, reliving past horrors, and piecing together the mansion’s dark history.

  • Burden of the Veil: Use Mina's gift to glimpse the otherworldly veil — at the cost of her sanity.

  • Flashback-Driven Storytelling: Experience haunting visions tied to objects, rooms, and restless spirits.

  • Modern Horror Design: A mix of atmospheric dread, psychological tension, and startling scares that honor the original while evolving the genre.

Enter the mansion. Face the memories. Let nothing you dismay.
